title: A fee bump whose inner transaction fails at apply with txNO_ACCOUNT
pattern: The inner transaction was valid when queued; a classic transaction earlier in the same ledger changed its source, and core re-checks the source at apply (TransactionFrame::commonValid, processSignatures): the inner source was merged earlier in the ledger; the fee source remains. The outer result is txFEE_BUMP_INNER_FAILED with txNO_ACCOUNT inside; the fee source pays. Readers that expect inner results to carry only operation failures, or treat a queued transaction as valid, get it wrong.

hazards.placement: InnerTransactionResult.txNO_ACCOUNT at apply: the inner source was merged earlier in the ledger; the fee source remains

facts.says: The inner transaction fails with txNO_ACCOUNT.
The classic transaction that caused it is in the same ledger.
